commands.command: SDK=${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}}; echo SYSTEM_IMAGES; find "$SDK/system-images" -maxdepth 4 -type f -name package.xml -print | sort; echo DIRS; find "$SDK/system-images" -mindepth 3 -maxdepth 3 -type d -print | sort; echo AVDS; "$SDK/emulator/emulator" -list-avds; echo DEVICES; "$SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/avdmanager" list device 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^id:|Name:' | head -80 || true
